findings.title: VenariX on X: Byod Group lists Vanderbilt University as potential ransomware victim
findings.summary_md: VenariX reported on X that the BYOD ransomware group listed Vanderbilt University as a potential victim of a ransomware cyberattack. The post notes Vanderbilt University provides education to over 13,500 students in Nashville, Tennessee.

findings.title: Dark Web Intelligence on X: BYOD ransomware gang claims Vanderbilt University breach
findings.summary_md: Dark Web Intelligence reported on X that the BYOD ransomware gang listed Vanderbilt University (vanderbilt.edu) on its leak site, saying its databases are locked. The post relays the group's claim that it holds the university's entire estate and research data.

findings.title: Vanderbilt University on X: active cybersecurity incident
findings.summary_md: Vanderbilt University posted on X that it was responding to an active cybersecurity incident that may impact university devices, systems, and cloud-based services. The university said its Information Technology team was actively investigating and working to contain the situation.

findings.title: Vanderbilt cybersecurity incident impacting campus devices and systems - The Record
findings.summary_md: The Record reported that Vanderbilt announced a cyberattack on Monday morning, warning that campus devices and systems may be impacted, and that the attack emerged early Monday after BYOD added the university to its leak site. Vanderbilt serves about 14,000 students and more than 6,000 staff; ransomware expert Allan Liska said BYOD's first victim appeared on September 29.

findings.title: Vanderbilt Orders Campus Offline as Ransomware Gang Says It Took Over the Network - databreach.com
findings.summary_md: databreach.com reported that BYOD's leak-site message claimed Vanderbilt's databases were locked and that it held over 1 million SSNs, full names, email addresses, phone numbers, student and employee records, and domain controller access. The report also noted VUIT staff went into classrooms Monday morning to warn faculty that school-issued computers were not safe to use, and that the AlertVU campus warning went out at 11:45 a.m.

findings.title: Cybersecurity breach impacts Vanderbilt University - Nashville Banner
findings.summary_md: The Nashville Banner reported that Vanderbilt was hit with a cyberattack Monday affecting multiple services, confirming outages impacting devices, systems, and cloud-based services. The report noted the hospital was not affected, as Vanderbilt University and Vanderbilt Health are legally and financially separate entities.
